trips.description: The Biblical birthplace of Jesus and hometown of David, surrounded by Mar Saba Monastery and Herodium (Herodion) Park.

trips.name: Ramallah
trips.description: Not so exciting, but a good starting point going further north in the West Bank. De facto seat of government of the Palestinian authority.

trips.name: Jericho
trips.description: One of the oldest settlements in the world and the Middle East, and a great starting point for Kalya Beach at the Dead Sea, which is famous in the region.

trips.name: Nablus
trips.description: One of the oldest cities in the world and famous for its kunafa/knafeh. If you are on a tight schedule and planning to go to Ramallah, you might want to skip the latter for this more exciting Palestinian city.

trips.name: Tel Aviv
trips.description: A big and the most cosmopolitan city in Israel, well known for its club culture.
